name: Glute Bridge March
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart, and arms pressed lightly at your sides.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips into a strong glute bridge with a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Keeping your hips high and level, lift one bent knee smoothly toward your chest, then set that foot firmly back down on the floor.
Alternate legs while keeping your pelvis level, then plant both feet and lower your hips to finish.
tips: Do not let your hips drop or twist toward the lifted leg when you shift onto one foot.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of your planted leg before lifting the opposite foot.
